title: Garden of Eden and Creation of Mankind

questions.question: What did God do on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:2 (ESV): "And on the seventh day God finished his work... and he rested."

questions.question: From what material did God form man?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:7 (ESV): "the LORD God formed the man of dust from the ground."

questions.question: Which tree was Adam forbidden to eat from?
options: The tree of knowledge of good and evil
questions.correctAnswer: The tree of knowledge of good and evil
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:17 (ESV): "of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat."

questions.question: From which part of Adam did God create woman?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:21-22: God took one of Adam's ribs and made a woman.

questions.question: Where did God place the man He had formed?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:8 (ESV): "the LORD God planted a garden in Eden... and there he put the man."

questions.question: What did God breathe into man's nostrils to give him life?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:7 (ESV): "breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being."

questions.question: What was the man's first task in the garden?
options: To work it and keep it
questions.correctAnswer: To work it and keep it
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:15 (ESV): "The LORD God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to work it and keep it."

questions.question: What did God say would happen if Adam ate from the forbidden tree?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:17 (ESV): "in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die."

questions.question: Why did God create woman?
options: Because it was not good for man to be alone
questions.correctAnswer: Because it was not good for man to be alone
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:18 (ESV): "It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper fit for him."

questions.question: What did Adam do when God brought the animals to him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:19-20: God brought the animals to Adam to see what he would call them.

questions.question: How many rivers flowed from Eden according to Genesis 2?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:10-14: Pishon, Gihon, Tigris (Hiddekel), and Euphrates.

questions.question: Which river flowed around the land of Cush?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:13 (ESV): "The name of the second river is the Gihon. It is the one that flows around the whole land of Cush."

questions.question: What precious materials were found in the land of Havilah where the Pishon flows?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:11-12: The gold of that land is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there.

questions.question: What did Adam call his wife and why?
options: Woman, because she was taken out of man
questions.correctAnswer: Woman, because she was taken out of man
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:23 (ESV): "She shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man."

questions.question: According to Genesis 2:24, what does a man do when he marries?
options: Leaves father and mother and holds fast to his wife
Enters a covenant with her family
questions.correctAnswer: Leaves father and mother and holds fast to his wife
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:24 (ESV): "a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh."

key_verse_text: Then the LORD God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.
